summary: This Form 6-K reports that ECARX Holdings Inc., through its wholly-owned subsidiary ECARX (Hubei) Ecological Investment Co., Ltd. and co-borrower ECARX Technology, entered into a syndicated loan agreement to finance the acquisition of 100% of Hubei Qiguang Technology Co., Ltd. The loan provides RMB1.26 billion (~$185M) at floating 5-year LPR+10bps, repayable semi-annually over 10 years. Collateral includes a pledge of Hubei Qiguang's equity and a guarantee from the target. Proceeds are exclusively for the acquisition. Watch for regulatory approvals and integration risk; the deal appears fully funded with committed debt.
